title: AI Flat Cartoon
description: Transforms the photo into a polished flat cartoon illustration.
positive_prompt: Transform the input photo into a polished flat cartoon illustration. Recreate all subjects, clothing, objects, and environment using clean vector-like shapes, smooth bold outlines, simplified geometry, solid color fills, and minimal cel shading. Use harmonious colors, crisp edges, and a modern 2D editorial cartoon aesthetic. Preserve recognizable facial features, hairstyles, expressions, clothing details, and characteristic silhouettes while simplifying them into expressive cartoon forms. Rendering contract: Use the input image as visual ground truth. Keep the exact number of subjects and their left-to-right order, relative scale, pose, gaze, interaction, and key props. For every visible person, retain recognizable face geometry, age range, skin tone, hairstyle, and distinguishing features in a style-appropriate form; do not beautify, age, or swap identity unless explicitly requested. Maintain original outfit colors, skin tones, age ranges, key props, and environmental context. Preserve the source aspect ratio, camera viewpoint, and all important content inside the frame unless this effect explicitly calls for a different layout. Apply the transformation consistently across the entire image to the subjects, clothing, props, and environment. Return one coherent finished image, not a before-and-after comparison, split screen, panels, borders, or unintended collage; use multiple frames or a decorative border only when this effect explicitly requests them. Include no readable text, letters, numerals, logos, signatures, watermarks, or interface elements unless explicitly requested.
negative_prompt: photorealism, 3D rendering, clay texture, realistic skin pores, heavy gradients, complex shading, painterly brushstrokes, sketchy lines, blurry outlines, excessive detail, distorted anatomy, changed identity, altered age, incorrect skin tone, missing subjects, extra people, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicate limbs, inconsistent cartoon style, text, captions, logos, watermarks, split screen, collage, identity drift, face swap, wrong subject count, duplicated subject, merged subjects, inconsistent transformation, partial transformation, before-and-after, unintended collage, accidental crop, cut-off face, broken hands, fused fingers, extra limbs, incoherent perspective, floating objects, random text, gibberish letters, numerals, signature, interface elements
custom_prompt_placeholder: e.g. bold outlines, editorial style, pastel colors...
